verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Recruitee browser extension or LinkedIn and web prospect capture. Several items are related but earn no credit. The candidate-creation API is a developer building block. "Build up your own database of potential candidates" is a general sourcing claim with no capture mechanism. The "Admin merged candidates" audit event is an adjacent merge feature, not deduplication at the point of capture.

support.subject: As a recruiter, a browser extension captures prospects from LinkedIn and the web straight into the ATS with deduplication
